fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: Glamsterdam fork on Sepolia successful; boring fork, gas limit ramped to 200M post-fork
ePBS builder participation on Sepolia low: ~4 active builders (Titan/Nico/Sigma Prime), large players absent
Hoodi fork scheduled Monday October 26 at 17:42 UTC; client releases required by October 16 (10-day notice)
Gas limit change confirmed to activate on the fork epoch for both Hoodi and Mainnet
Mainnet shadow fork accidentally activated Gloas; now being used for Snap 2 testing with large blocks; benchmarking shadow fork relaunching next week

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-7907 (contract size metering): PFI raised by Ben Adams; EIP-7954 raised contract limit without metering, creating DoS surface; decision deferred to next call
CFI: EIP-5920 (PAY opcode) — medium complexity, broad support
CFI: EIP-8151 (ecRecover deprecation) and EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM) — paired as PQ EOA migration path
CFI: EIP-8360 (TCREATE opcode) and EIP-4758 (Deactivate SELFDESTRUCT) — paired; fix for issue introduced in Glamsterdam
CFI: EIP-7709 (read BLOCKHASH from storage) — upgraded to A-tier by Nethermind; benefits BAL light-client use case
CFI: EIP-8077 (eth/xx mempool networking) — conditional on deeper analysis including frame/fee fields
DFI: EIP-7666 (EVM-ify identity precompile) — gas pricing edge cases and low value; consensus shifted to DFI after jochem-brouwer raised spec issues
DFI: EIP-8355 (ML-DSA precompile) — no consensus on lattice schemes; zkEVM cost concerns; hash-based approach preferred
CFI: EIP-8116 (replace cumulative receipt fields) — low priority, placed at bottom of CFI list
DFI: EIP-8374 (persist warm access sets across reverts) — lukewarm support, deep fork boundary change not worth complexity

complexity_and_tooling.highlight: danceratopz presented LLM-based retrospective EIP complexity assessments; 14 CFI/SFI EIPs already make Hegota the most complex fork on record before any additional PFIs
Łukasz Rozmej: Nethermind has 150+ Hegota PRs; bottleneck is coordination/testing, not implementation; advocates for better tooling and EIP champion involvement

action_items.action: EIP-8077 champion to expand proposal to include fee/frame fields beyond sender+nonce for mempool filtering
Review Glamsterdam Ecosystem Readiness Checklist PR (#2266) for enterprise Sepolia feedback collection

Gas limit change activates on fork epoch for Hoodi and Mainnet
EIP-7907 (contract size metering) added to PFI list; decision deferred to next call

CFI for Hegota: EIP-5920 (PAY opcode), EIP-8151 (ecRecover), EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM), EIP-8360 (TCREATE), EIP-4758 (Deactivate SELFDESTRUCT), EIP-7709 (BLOCKHASH from storage), EIP-8077 (eth/xx networking), EIP-8116 (replace cumulative receipt fields)
DFI for Hegota: EIP-7666 (EVM-ify identity precompile), EIP-8355 (ML-DSA precompile), EIP-8374 (persist warm access sets across reverts)
